governed_construct: One integration attached to an API Gateway endpoint in infrastructure-as-code (AWS CDK): each `new X(...)` of an API Gateway integration class (LambdaIntegration, AwsIntegration, MockIntegration, HttpIntegration, Integration, apigatewayv2 HttpLambdaIntegration / HttpUrlIntegration / other Http*Integration), each `LambdaRestApi` construction (its implicit integration), and each L1 `CfnMethod` `integration: { type: ... }` object literal.
interpretation: Every API Gateway endpoint must be wired to a Lambda function through a Lambda proxy (AWS_PROXY) integration. Conforming instances: `new LambdaIntegration(fn)` with no `proxy` option or `proxy: true` (the CDK default is proxy); `LambdaRestApi` (always a Lambda proxy integration); apigatewayv2 `HttpLambdaIntegration` (always proxy); `new Integration({ type: IntegrationType.AWS_PROXY, ... })`; `CfnMethod` with `integration.type: 'AWS_PROXY'`. Non-conforming instances: `LambdaIntegration` with `proxy: false` (non-proxy Lambda integration with mapping templates); `AwsIntegration` (custom/non-proxy, even when service is 'lambda'); `MockIntegration`; `HttpIntegration`, `HttpUrlIntegration` or any non-Lambda integration (the endpoint does not use Lambda proxy at all); `Integration`/`CfnMethod` with type AWS, MOCK, HTTP or HTTP_PROXY. A file with no API Gateway integration or LambdaRestApi is NOT_APPLICABLE (Lambda functions alone are not endpoints). Mentions of integration names or `proxy: false` inside comments or string literals are not instances. A file is SATISFIED only if every instance conforms; a single non-conforming integration makes it VIOLATED.
